title: Qwen3-VL 8B Instruct (llama.cpp) start parameters
description: Start-time configuration only. These values are substituted into the launch command and decide how the child process places its weights, so changing any of them restarts the arm. Per-job values (the system prompt, the prompt, the images, max tokens, sampling) are sent to the running arm as a job and are validated by the arm itself.

model.description: The GGUF, relative to the managed storage directory. Qwen's own Q8_0 conversion: at 8B the 4-bit files save four gigabytes the card does not need saved, and a prompt rewriter is judged on its wording.

mmproj.description: The vision projector, relative to the managed storage directory. Always loaded: reading the reference images is what this arm is for.

inputDir.description: Root that a job's images are confined to. The same root the image and video arms read their references from, so one media id names the same file to all of them.

contextSize.description: Tokens of context the child reserves up front. An image costs roughly a thousand tokens at the projector's default resolution, so 16384 holds nine references, the instructions and the answer with room to spare. About 144 KiB per token at f16.

gpuLayers.description: Layers on the card. 999 is all of them, which a dense 8B model at Q8_0 fits on a 16 GiB card.

flashAttention.description: The child's --flash-attn. auto enables it where the backend supports it.

threads.description: CPU threads. -1 lets the child choose. With every layer on the card this barely matters.

kvCacheType.description: Data type of the KV cache, for both K and V. q8_0 halves it, for when a longer context is wanted on the same card.
